schemes.name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts.
documents_required: Bank Account details (Aadhaar linked NPCI seeded)
schemes.appeal_authority: District Agriculture Officer / PM-Kisan State Nodal Officer

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
schemes.hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
schemes.summary: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

benefits.coverage: Over 1,949 medical treatments across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals

eligibility.family_criteria: No cap on family size or age

documents_required: Ration Card (NFSA or State BPL Card)
Income Certificate / PM-JAY Family ID verification
schemes.appeal_authority: District Medical Officer / State Health Agency (SHA)

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors Scheme)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.summary: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan to street vendors starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.

benefits.financial: Tranche 1: ₹10,000; Tranche 2: ₹20,000; Tranche 3: ₹50,000 loan + 7% interest subsidy + ₹1,200/yr digital cashback

eligibility.vending_proof: Vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB

documents_required: Urban Local Body (ULB) Vending Certificate or Town Vending Committee (TVC) ID

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.summary: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople: recognized PM Vishwakarma Certificate, ₹15,000 toolkit grant, and 5% concessional credit up to ₹3 Lakhs.

benefits.financial: ₹15,000 Toolkit Incentive + ₹1 Lakh (18 months) & ₹2 Lakhs (30 months) collateral-free loan at 5% interest
benefits.skill: Basic 5-7 days training with ₹500/day stipend + Advanced training
benefits.identity: Official PM Vishwakarma Digital Certificate and ID Card

eligibility.tradition: Engaged in one of 18 identified traditional family trades

documents_required: Ration Card / Self-declaration of traditional trade

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for pucca house construction with toilet.

benefits.financial: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 grant in installments + ₹12,000 Swachh Bharat toilet grant + 90 days MGNREGA wages (approx ₹20,000)

documents_required: Photograph of existing kutcha dwelling site

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.hindi_name: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (बेटी बचाओ, बेटी पढ़ाओ)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance / Post Office & Banks
schemes.summary: High-interest (8.2%) government-backed savings scheme for girl children up to age 10 with Section 80C tax exemption and maturity at 21 years.

benefits.interest_rate: 8.2% annual compounded interest (highest sovereign safe yield)
benefits.maturity: Full maturity payout on higher education (18 yrs) or marriage (21 yrs)

eligibility.target: Parents/legal guardians of girl child below 10 years of age

schemes.appeal_authority: Superintendent of Post Offices / Lead Bank Manager

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.hindi_name: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
schemes.summary: Monthly pension support for widowed women living below poverty line between ages 40 and 79.

benefits.financial: ₹1,000 - ₹3,000 / month (depending on State topping up the Central ₹300 grant)

documents_required: BPL Card or Valid Income Certificate (< ₹1,00,000/yr)
schemes.appeal_authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / District Social Welfare Officer

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu & Kishore)
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.summary: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹50,000 (Shishu) and up to ₹5,00,000 (Kishore) for micro-enterprises, small shops, and artisans.

benefits.financial: Up to ₹50,000 (Shishu) / ₹5,00,000 (Kishore) no-collateral credit at competitive bank interest rates

documents_required: Quotation/Estimate for machinery or business stock
schemes.appeal_authority: District Lead Bank Manager / State Level Bankers Committee

schemes.name: RTE Section 12(1)(c) Free School Admission
schemes.hindi_name: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) - 25% निःशुल्क निजी स्कूल प्रवेश
schemes.summary: Mandatory 25% reserved seats in recognized private unaided schools for children from Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and disadvantaged groups with zero tuition fees up to Class 8.

benefits.value: 100% Free Tuition, Books, and Uniforms in nearby top private schools from Nursery/Class 1 up to Class 8
benefits.impact: Saves ₹30,000 - ₹80,000 per year in school fees

documents_required: Domicile / Address proof within 1-3 km of school
schemes.appeal_authority: Basic Shiksha Adhikari (BSA) / District Education Officer (DEO)

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.hindi_name: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
schemes.ministry: Women and Child Development Department, UP
schemes.summary: Conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 (revised) across 6 milestones from girl child's birth to graduation.

benefits.financial: Total ₹25,000 grant paid in 6 phases: birth (₹5k), vaccination (₹2k), Class 1 (₹3k), Class 6 (₹3k), Class 9 (₹5k), Diploma/Degree (₹7k)

schemes.name: MP Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
schemes.hindi_name: मध्य प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना
schemes.ministry: Women and Child Development Department, MP
schemes.summary: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,250 transferred directly into the bank accounts of married women aged 21-60.
documents_required: Samagra Family ID & Member ID (e-KYC completed)
schemes.appeal_authority: Gram Panchayat Sachiv / Ward Incharge / SDM

schemes.name: e-Shram National Unorganized Workers Register
schemes.summary: Universal Account Number (UAN) with free accidental insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 under PMSBY and priority DBT access in crises.

benefits.insurance: ₹2 Lakh accidental death / permanent disability cover + ₹1 Lakh partial disability
benefits.social_security: Direct linkage to state welfare boards and central emergency assistance

documents_required: Bank Account details (Savings Bank Account No. & IFSC)
